target_window.tail: NO_NEW_ENTRIES_LAST40_SESSIONS; retain any unexecutable exit at end with marked exposure

selection_and_risk: V1 price-volume selection, caps, entry/exit/fee parameters retained; no optimization

decision_clock.source_available_at: actual observation/retrieval, never simulated historical clock
decision_clock.assumption: Supplier reconstructed end-of-day records assumed available by simulated post-close decision; not proof of original PIT. No same-day execution.

suspension.feature_bars: skip suspension; require 21 consecutive observed tradable bars after suspension before new entry

corporate_actions.bonus_ratio: extra shares per old share, no bonus=0
corporate_actions.price_comparison: on ex-date only transform all then-known prior prices/stop/entry comparison by (price-gross_cash)/(split+bonus); no future adjustment factors
corporate_actions.cash_receivable: net after simulated tax, NAV from ex-date, spendable only pay_date
corporate_actions.new_shares: integer only, valued ex-date but locked until shares_available_date
corporate_actions.unsupported: rights issuance, merger, fractional entitlement, unknown dates or coverage block; never fill NONE

errors: retain all preceding and current-day completed entries, mark partial invalid and failed_at
